explanation: Move the smaller rings to the spare peg, move the largest ring to the destination, then move the smaller rings onto it. The recursive calls always move a legal tower and transfer the complete stack from peg 0 to peg 1.
spaceComplexity: O(n) recursion space, plus O(2^n) output space.
